text:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up: NovaGrid flagged high-risk in weekly account health. ~60% drop in active API keys last 10 days and their champion (A. Soto) moved teams. Need quick triage.
Emily (AM): Yikes. Is the drop across routes or concentrated?
Maya (CSM): concentrated on /v1/convert ingestion route; embeddings also down ~55%. Sharing snapshot.
Raj (SE): paste the query so I can check telemetry and KV cache hit rates.
Maya (CSM): SQL I used:
```sql
SELECT route, date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, count(*) AS calls
FROM requests
WHERE customer_id = 'novagrid' AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 2 DESC;
```
Maya (CSM): top numbers: 2026-03-10: 1,120; 2026-03-17: 450; 2026-03-20: 420.
ops-bot: Alert: quota usage below baseline for two windows.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Any support tickets or product issues?
Maya (CSM): Two latency tickets ~3 weeks ago, both closed after a hotfix. No open FRs.
Emily (AM): Procurement requested a competitor POC last week per notes. Could be re-eval.
Raj (SE): I'll run routing/checks for model fallbacks and cache hits. Give me 30m.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Suggestion: offer a 2-week dedicated sandbox + focused enablement for their new ML lead. We’ve seen it help renewals.
Maya (CSM): Agreed. Also propose a short ops/dev/procurement QBR. Emily can schedule?
Emily (AM): Yep, pinging them now. Tentative Wed 10 11 PT.
Maya (CSM): Raj, can you draft a diagnostics runbook we can send to them?
Raj (SE): Draft: "Run `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` and record 10 consecutive p50/p95 latency samples; attach last 3 request logs for /v1/convert."
Maya (CSM): Perfect. I'll DM NovaGrid offering sandbox + workshop.
Ben (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a 30-min workshop: batching knobs, cache hints, example prompts.
Emily (AM): Marking renewal play as "advocate-exit" in CRM and adding pilot extension offer.
Maya (CSM): Actions: 1) Raj run telemetry check (30m) 2) Ben prep workshop (24h) 3) Emily schedule QBR & update CRM 4) Maya outreach with sandbox.
Raj (SE): Quick check done: no model fallback, but KV cache hit rate dropped from 78% to 12% between 2026-03-10 and 2026-03-20  likely client-side cache invalidation.
Maya (CSM): That explains token cost spike and churn. I'll call them to confirm client changes and push sandbox.
Emily (AM): If procurement pushes price vs competitor, offer two-week pilot extension + workshop and ask for a 1-page POC spec with 3 success criteria.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team, will update here after outreach. :thumbsup:
